title: A Journey to the West
synopsis: “A Journey to the West” is the most famous out of the Four Great Classical Novels of China.

fullText.simplified:
西游记

    《西游记》和《三国演义》、《红楼梦》、《水浒传》一起，被称为中国的四大名著。《西游记》是一部中国古典神怪小说，作者是吴承恩，成书于16世纪的明朝。在四大名著里，《西游记》应该是最为人们所熟知的。因为这几百年来，《西游记》被改编成了各种地方戏曲、电视剧、电影、动画片、漫画等，版本很多，所以从小孩到老人没有不知道《西游记》的。
    《西游记》讲的是这样一个故事：那是一个人类、妖怪与神仙共处的神话世界。神仙掌管着天界与人间，妖怪们或是偷偷下凡的神仙小跟班，或是自己修炼成精，他们时刻危害着人类世界。人间的皇帝派唐僧去西天寻找一部写满真理的经书，他必须亲自一步一步地走到西天，历尽所有磨难才能得到宝物。各路妖魔鬼怪等在沿途，因为他们相信唐僧肉可以长生不老的传言，所以他们都想抓到唐僧，吃唐僧肉。而孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧这三个犯了错误，被贬到人间的神仙，只有帮助唐僧完成这个任务才能修成正果，重回天界。于是，唐僧成了孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧的师父，他们一起去西天取经，孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧保护唐僧不被沿途的妖魔鬼怪吃掉。他们历尽千辛万苦，最后终于到达了西天，取到了真经，修成了正果。
fullText.traditional:
西遊記

    《西遊記》和《三國演義》、《紅樓夢》、《水滸傳》一起，被稱為中國的四大名著。《西遊記》是一部中國古典神怪小說，作者是吳承恩，成書於16世紀的明朝。在四大名著裡，《西遊記》應該是最為人們所熟知的。因為這幾百年來，《西遊記》被改編成了各種地方戲曲、電視劇、電影、動畫片、漫畫等，版本很多，所以從小孩到老人沒有不知道《西遊記》的。
    《西遊記》講的是這樣一個故事：那是一個人類、妖怪與神仙共處的神話世界。神仙掌管著天界與人間，妖怪們或是偷偷下凡的神仙小跟班，或是自己修煉成精，他們時刻危害著人類世界。人間的皇帝派唐僧去西天尋找一部寫滿真理的經書，他必須親自一步一步地走到西天，歷盡所有磨難才能得到寶物。各路妖魔鬼怪等在沿途，因為他們相信唐僧肉可以長生不老的傳言，所以他們都想抓到唐僧，吃唐僧肉。而孫悟空、豬八戒和沙僧這三個犯了錯誤，被貶到人間的神仙，只有幫助唐僧完成這個任務才能修成正果，重回天界。於是，唐僧成了孫悟空、豬八戒和沙僧的師父，他們一起去西天取經，孫悟空、豬八戒和沙僧保護唐僧不被沿途的妖魔鬼怪吃掉。他們歷盡千辛萬苦，最後終於到達了西天，取到了真經，修成了正果。

sentences.pinyin: gè lù yāo mó guǐ guài děng zài yán tú

sentences.english: All kinds of monsters and evil spirits awaited him along the way.

sentences.simplified: 所以他们都想抓到唐僧，吃唐僧肉。
sentences.traditional: 所以他們都想抓到唐僧，吃唐僧肉。

sentences.english: Because they all believed a rumor that Xuanzang's meat could make them immortal ..

sentences.english: .. so they were all eager to catch and eat his meat.

sentences.simplified: 只有帮助唐僧完成这个任务才能修成正果，重回天界。
sentences.traditional: 只有幫助唐僧完成這個任務才能修成正果，重回天界。

sentences.english: Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng, were three immortals who made mistakes and were exiled to earth.

sentences.simplified: 于是，唐僧成了孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧的师父，他们一起去西天取经，

sentences.english: They had to help Xuanzang finish his task, in order to become immortals again and return to the heavens.

sentences.simplified: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧保护唐僧不被沿途的妖魔鬼怪吃掉。
sentences.traditional: 孫悟空、豬八戒和沙僧保護唐僧不被沿途的妖魔鬼怪吃掉。
sentences.pinyin: sūn wù kōng zhū bā jiè hé shā sēng bǎo hù táng sēng bú bèi yán tú de yāo mó guǐ guài chī diào
sentences.english: So, Xuanzang became Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng's master, and they traveled together to the West.

sentences.simplified: 他们历尽千辛万苦，最后终于到达了西天，取到了真经，修成了正果。
sentences.traditional: 他們歷盡千辛萬苦，最後終於到達了西天，取到了真經，修成了正果。
sentences.pinyin: tā men lì jìn qiān xīn wàn kǔ zuì hòu zhōng yú dào dá le xī tiān qǔ dào le zhēn jīng xiū chéng le zhèng guǒ
sentences.english: Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng protected Xuanzang from being eaten by monsters and evil spirits on the way.
After countless hardships, they finally arrived at their destination, acquired the scripts, and became immortals.

sentence_translations: A Journey to the West
“A Journey to the West”, “Romance of Three Kingdoms”, “Dream of the Red Chamber”, and “Water Margin” ..
.. are known as the Four Great Classical Novels of China.
“A Journey to the West” is a classic novel of gods and spirits of China.
The author Wu Cheng’en wrote it in the 16th century Ming Dynasty.
Out of the Four Great Classical Novels, “A Journey to the West” is the most well known.
Because over the last 100 years it has been adapted to local operas, TV series, movies, cartoons, and comics.
There are so many versions of it, that everyone knows “A Journey to the West”, from little children to elders.
“A Journey to the West” tells the following story:
It is a mythological world where humans, monsters and immortals co-exist.
The immortals are in charge of heaven and earth.
Monsters, god attendants who secretly slipped to earth, and evil spirits who practiced and became monsters, ..
.. they all pose a constant threat against the world of humans.
The emperor of the humans sent the monk Xuanzang to go to the West to look for scripts of truth.
He had to walk there himself, one step at a time, and endure all kinds of hardship before acquiring the treasure.
All kinds of monsters and evil spirits awaited him along the way.
Because they all believed a rumor that Xuanzang's meat could make them immortal ..
.. so they were all eager to catch and eat his meat.
Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng, were three immortals who made mistakes and were exiled to earth.
They had to help Xuanzang finish his task, in order to become immortals again and return to the heavens.
So, Xuanzang became Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng's master, and they traveled together to the West.
Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie and Sha Seng protected Xuanzang from being eaten by monsters and evil spirits on the way.
After countless hardships, they finally arrived at their destination, acquired the scripts, and became immortals.
